answer: The mechanism is reciprocity-weighted attestation with payouts held in escrow until finality. Each reviewer draws a slot from an anchor pool it has never earned in, re-checks the claim against on-chain receipts, and forfeits its own escrow if a later audit overturns the verdict. A new identity enters with zero history, so the whole lagoon of unverified work counts against it and its votes carry near-zero weight. Splitting into a thousand leaves multiplies the onyx locked per leaf while earned weight stays flat.
